statement: Normal SDL open produced 17 successful setting 9 = 0 writes approximately three seconds apart. Mouse reports during right-pad movement counted 773 before, zero during and 718 after the SDL session. A still produced three Enter presses and three releases in each window, including while SDL held the device. No setting 71 or command 0x81 was observed in this session. Successful empty 0x85 and 0x8e writes at close preceded resumed mouse output. A separate hands-off reconnect observed 0xae, 0x83, 0x85 and 0x8e writes, native reports and no mouse/keyboard reports. This is kernel attach/close restoration evidence, not firmware power-on defaults or autonomous watchdog evidence.

applicability.firmware: Not independently re-read in each action session; no firmware update performed
applicability.scope: Bounded owner-guided windows and normal SDL open/close only; no wireless, watchdog or calibrated transfer function.
